# SkyOps Parking

Product key: skyops-parking
Canonical product: https://skyopsparking.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/skyops-parking/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/skyops-parking/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- airport parking management software
- parking garage reservation management
- parking owner dashboard
- multi-location parking operations software
- valet-style vehicle staging and retrieval

## Authority

public product discovery and human-directed pilot or planning flows

## Boundaries

- planning is not a parking reservation
- displayed planning values are not proof of a charge
- payments, messaging, hardware, and partner connections must be verified per deployment
